reviews.comment:
Pros:
* Flexible with deadlines
* Grading scale is 87=A, 77=B, etc
* Provides some of the exam problems in review
* Kind

Con:
* Hand writing is small/illegible 
* Lectures arent helpful but attendance is graded
* Cant really ask questions in class
* Doesnt use Canvas
* Homework covers material not taught yet
* Expectations on proofs unclear

Professor Larson really pushes you to learn the material. He gives exam question possibilities that he selects from. If you're willing to pour over the proofs he gives and commit them to memory for the exams, then you will do well in the class. You also don't have to take the final if you already have an A in the class by the time of the final.

Extremely nice professor. I loved the way he cares about his students. It is not hard to pass this class with him as long as you show up. He is a little old school, so there is no Canvas or online website for this course and you don't really know your grade. He had night exams and tells you most of whats on it. Each exam is about 2 hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As lenient as he is on certain things, Not sure I can give any higher than a 2. He assigns homework a week before the topic is covered in lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: honestly the worst lecturer i've had so far. gives out homework every week over material that isn't taught in class until a week later. his lectures are just him writing 1-2 proofs and sometimes just copies it from the book. his exams are 95% like the reviews, and he's lenient on deadlines. if it weren't for the attendance, i would skip class.

I'm not sure I would call him a great teacher as he only explains 1 or 2 problems a class and spends the rest of the time passing back papers or rambling. But he tells you exactly what will be on the exams and even gave us 3 chances on the first quiz because he wants everyone to pass. Do the homework and study what he tells you for exams  A.
Best math professor I have ever had, truly cares about his students. Gives test problems ahead of time to study and his office hours are always so helpful . Great person and professor.
